content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00306, SRS_Rte_00301 When a Data Communication Graph is associated to a Cross Software Cluster Communication Plug-In , the RTE shall support the mapping of DataReceivedEvent s to periodically activated OsTask s. In this case the RTE shall check the activation of the according DataReceivedEvent with the related Rte_- Rips_DataIsUpdated_EventActivation service.
